uutiset.t: Nextdc Says It Will No Longer Develop Data Centers Near Homes
uutiset.s: Australian data center company Nextdc has vowed not to develop sites near residential areas after community opposition and power constraints delayed a major expansion project.

uutiset.t: Copper Rout Deepens as AI Selloff Wreaks Havoc in Metals Markets
uutiset.s: Copper crashed to its lowest level since March after a week of market turmoil fueled by deepening worries about global demand.

uutiset.s: Donald Trump, 80, offered Xi Jinping, 73, a hand while boarding an escalator, with Xi holding his forearm as he stepped up, during their third summit of the year in Shenzhen. uutiset.t: Honda Debuts Hybrid SUV for Asia in Pivot From Failed EV Bet
uutiset.s: Honda Motor Co. unwrapped a new flagship SUV, the first of a range of gas-electric hybrid models the company is rolling out this decade as part of its pivot away from fully electric cars.

uutiset.t: Rising Bond Yields May Pose a Challenge to Nifty’s Sharp Rebound
uutiset.s: The Nifty has rebounded almost 15% since early October, pushing valuations higher.

uutiset.t: Taiwan Stocks Face Worst Week Since 1991 Despite Support Steps
uutiset.s: Taiwan’s tech-heavy stock market witnessed another selloff on Friday as the global artificial intelligence trade came under fresh strain, putting the island’s benchmark on course for its worst week since 1991.

uutiset.t: Hong Kong Stocks Fall 20% From 2026 High as AI Selloff Spreads
uutiset.s: Hong Kong stocks fell toward a grim milestone as an AI-led selloff spread to engulf even the more defensive corners of the market.

uutiset.t: Anthropic (ANT) IPO on Nasdaq Overcame AI Fears and Warnings
uutiset.s: The pioneering AI lab saw unprecedented demand for its stock from both retail and institutional investors.

uutiset.t: Frasers CFO Unleashes on Accent as Australian Bid Turns Personal
uutiset.s: Frasers Group Plc’s pursuit of Australia’s Accent Group Ltd. turned personal after Frasers’ finance chief flew to the retailer’s annual meeting in Melbourne to publicly accuse it of under-performance and demand the chairman quit.

uutiset.t: Australian Pension Funds Confront Their Latest Rival: AI Agents
uutiset.s: Top Australian pension funds are grappling with the potential proliferation of autonomous AI agents, a new source of competition in the lucrative retirement market which senior executives say is creating significant challenges.

uutiset.s: Power dynamics were on full display as the leaders of the US, China, and Russia met on the sidelines of the APEC summit in Shenzhen. uutiset.t: RBA Seeks to Manage Inflation, Jobs Tradeoffs, Board Member Says
uutiset.s: Australia’s central bank is trying to manage the difficult tradeoffs in monetary policy of how much weight to put on inflation and how much on employment, as required under its mandate, said Renee Fry-McKibbin, a member of the Reserve Bank’s rate-setting board.

uutiset.t: Dollar Heads for Fourth Week of Gains Following Anthropic IPO
uutiset.s: The dollar is headed for a fourth straight weekly gain as demand tied to the Anthropic PBC IPO further lifts the currency that has been supported by expectations of further Federal Reserve interest-rate hikes and elevated US Treasury yields.

uutiset.t: Japan Tobacco Shares Fall After Russia-Related Charges
uutiset.s: Japan Tobacco Inc. shares declined after the cigarette maker said it expects to swing to an operating loss and slashed its dividend forecast after losing control of its Russian business.

uutiset.t: Gold Set for Worst Week Since March on Hawkish Fed, AI Selloff
uutiset.s: Gold fell for a fifth day — heading for the biggest weekly decline since March — as a hawkish Federal Reserve signaled more interest-rate hikes and a rout in AI stocks pushed investors to sell the metal to cover losses.
